extras: Supports both desktop and mobile; converts images to WebP using Chromium and integrates into the native hover toolbar.
intentEvidence: It adds its buttons to the built-in hover toolbar that Obsidian itself shows in the top-right corner of an embedded image
problem: Managing large image files and attachments within Obsidian is cumbersome, often leading to bloated vaults and inefficient workflows.
summary: Adds a toolbar to embedded images allowing users to resize, rename, convert to WebP, reveal in file explorer, copy, and delete unused attachments.
